summary: Finance transformation and shared services training for finance professionals. Build scorecards, service catalogs, and roadmaps.
lede: Finance transformation and shared services bring finance processes into a more consistent operating model with clearer governance and performance measures. For finance operations, shared services, and transformation professionals, the course covers assessing current processes, mapping invoice-to-pay and record-to-report workflows, and designing service catalogs, control matrices, scorecards, and transformation roadmaps.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for finance professionals who must redesign shared services, improve process performance, and report transformation results with confidence. It suits people who already work inside finance operations or adjacent reporting roles and need practical methods for operating model change. Finance Operations Manager responsible for process standardization and service delivery. Shared Services Manager overseeing transaction processing and SLA performance. Finance Transformation Lead coordinating operating model redesign and roadmap delivery. Controller managing close discipline, control design, and reporting quality. FP&A Analyst supporting KPI analysis and benefits tracking. Accounts Payable Manager reducing invoice exceptions and payment delays. Accounts Receivable Manager improving cash application and dispute workflows. Record-to-Report Specialist improving journal, reconciliation, and close cycles. Finance Systems Analyst supporting ERP workflow and master data readiness. CFO office advisor tracking transformation milestones and executive reporting.
prerequisites: You need a laptop for workshop exercises, plus access to sample finance process data such as SLA reports, close calendars, invoice volumes, or workflow metrics where available. Familiarity with Excel or a comparable spreadsheet tool will help you complete the scorecard, prioritization, and roadmap exercises effectively.
